subject: journey/nautilus
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A single landscape 3:2 illustration for the historical atlas sketchbook of Jules Verne's Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea. A nineteenth-century naturalist's field sketch in graphite and sepia pen with restrained transparent watercolour washes on warm ivory paper. Fine irregular parallel hatching, economical contour lines, a few details sharply observed; leave areas of cream paper around irregular unfinished edges. One coherent scene that reads at small sizes. No captions, labels, border, binding, signatures, photorealism, modern equipment, or Disney submarine designs. Newfoundland Grand Banks underwater naturalist study. Several Atlantic cod with mottled backs, three dorsal fins and small chin barbels hover above a gravel bank littered with shells and scattered rounded boulders. The submarine’s light falls across the steep edge.
